edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1 and terrain-only — no wall, no swing; fight him in open lane. - Comeuppance: 100/85/70s channel — W-stun or Aegis it. - Guard your E (22s rank 1) like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: His swing ends on contact — colliding with a champion knocks him off E, so walk at the arc, not away.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: His passive shields him every third hit — burst into a fresh Dirty Fighting shield and the all-in maths quietly stop adding up.

edits.before: Akshan wants to poke with Avengerang (Q) and dash off your minions with Heroic Swing (E), but your point-and-click E-W-Q ignores his mobility. When he E-swings to reposition, W-stun him mid-dash and burst him. His early trading is weak up close, so close the gap and never let him kite in open lane.
edits.after: Akshan wants to poke with Avengerang (Q) and swing around terrain with Heroic Swing (E) — but the hook needs a wall, so in open lane he has no dash. When he swings, W-stun him mid-arc or body-block it: colliding with a champion knocks him off. His early trading is weak up close, so close the gap and keep him off the walls.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are your all-in window; your point-and-click E-W-Q catches him through Heroic Swing and your W stun interrupts his Comeuppance channel. Punish every time he swings off a minion to reposition and choke the wave so he can't kite you.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are your all-in window; your point-and-click E-W-Q catches him through Heroic Swing and your W stun interrupts his Comeuppance channel. Punish him each time he grapples a wall — a body-block knocks him off — and choke the wave so he can't kite you.

edits.before: Kite in open lane with Q poke and E dashes off minions
edits.after: Kite with Q poke and terrain swings from Heroic Swing
